name: system_info
title: System information
description: Read system information from a device.

name: health_snapshot
title: Health snapshot
description: Read-only health snapshot of a device: CPU usage and load, memory and swap, disks, network counters, and the top processes by CPU and memory. Includes observedAt and limitations.

name: server_overview
title: Server overview
description: Linux server overview, read-only: hostname, OS, kernel, uptime, load, CPU %, memory and swap, disks, whether a reboot is required, pending updates, process and zombie counts, and whether this agent can act as root (privilege). The same data as the app's Sunucu yönetimi > Genel bakış.

name: server_disk_usage
title: Disk usage
description: What fills a Linux disk, read-only: the 40 largest folders directly inside path (default /), sizes in KB, never crossing into another disk, plus Docker's own usage at /. Large disks can take a minute or two.

name: server_cleanup_scan
title: Find what can be cleaned
description: Read-only: what can be safely freed on a Linux server, by category (apt cache, journal older than 7 days, rotated logs, old temp files, crash dumps) and, for every Docker daemon separately (the system one and each user's rootless one, listed in dockers with storage folder, running containers and any error), its build cache and unused images, with the size and the exact command each cleanup runs. Ids of a rootless daemon end in @u<uid>. Use the ids with server_cleanup_run.

name: server_cleanup_run
title: Clean up disk space
description: Frees disk space on a Linux server: runs the fixed cleanup commands of the given categories (ids from server_cleanup_scan) as root; a Docker id goes to the daemon it names, through Docker's own prune. Only known, re-creatable files; application data, databases, containers and Docker volumes are never touched. Needs a human approval for this exact call.

name: server_processes
title: Server processes
description: Linux processes, read-only: every process (pid, parent, user, state, CPU, memory, run time, command) and the zombie processes grouped by parent, with the container or systemd service that owns the parent and whether that parent is protected (the processes that keep the server reachable).

name: server_timers_list
title: Server timers and cron
description: Scheduled jobs on a Linux server, read-only and without root: systemd timers (system, and the agent user's own) with schedule, next and last run, the service and command they start and its last result, plus cron entries (the user's crontab, /etc/crontab, /etc/cron.d, /etc/cron.hourly to monthly). unreadable lists what could not be read or is never read (other users' crontabs).

name: server_process_signal
title: Signal a process
description: Sends a signal to one Linux process: action 'reap' asks a parent to collect its zombies (SIGCHLD, harmless), 'term' asks it to stop, 'kill' stops it at once. name must still match the process (a PID reused by another program is refused); the processes that keep the server reachable are refused; a database needs confirm_database. Needs a human approval for this exact call.

name: server_restart_owner
title: Restart a container or service
description: Restarts the Docker container or systemd service that a process runs in (from server_processes zombie owners); its zombies go with the old process. SSH, Docker, containerd, journald, logind, D-Bus and WECOMMANDER itself are refused. Needs a human approval for this exact call.

id.description: Container id (12+ hex) or unit name ending in .service.

name: docker_containers_list
title: List Docker containers
description: Linux Docker containers, read-only, per daemon: the system daemon and each user's rootless one (daemon id system or u<uid>, the same daemons as server_cleanup_scan). Each container has id (the full 64-hex id), name, image, state, status, created, ports and restart count. A daemon that cannot be read carries its error instead. daemon limits the list to one daemon. Works on agent devices and SSH targets.

daemon.description: Docker daemon from docker_containers_list: system (default) or u<uid> for a user's rootless one.

name: docker_container_logs
title: Read container logs
description: Read-only: the last lines of one container's logs (stdout and stderr merged, timestamped, oldest first). tail 1-2000 (default 200); since limits the window (10m, 1h30m, a Unix time or an RFC 3339 time). At most 256 KiB, newest lines kept; secrets are masked. Works on agent devices and SSH targets.

container.description: Container id or name from docker_containers_list; ref@u<uid> names a rootless daemon.

daemon.description: Docker daemon from docker_containers_list: system (default) or u<uid> for a user's rootless one.

name: docker_container_action
title: Start, stop or restart a container
description: Starts, stops or restarts one Docker container on the daemon it names (stop and restart wait 10 s before killing); the action runs on the full id Docker resolves the reference to. Never removes containers, images or volumes; WECOMMANDER's own containers are never stopped or restarted. Needs a human approval for every call, also on fully trusted devices; refused on read-only SSH targets.

container.description: Container id or name from docker_containers_list; ref@u<uid> names a rootless daemon.

daemon.description: Docker daemon from docker_containers_list: system (default) or u<uid> for a user's rootless one.

annotations.title: Start, stop or restart a container

name: log_query
title: Search logs
description: Read-only, bounded log search on a device, newest first. source 'journal' (Linux systemd journal: since_minutes window, unit, level) or 'file' (tail of a log file inside the allowed roots). Filters: level (error|warning|info|debug, default info), pattern (case-insensitive regex), limit (1-1000, default 100). Repeated messages are grouped; secrets are masked.

unit.description: systemd unit for source 'journal', e.g. ssh.service.

name: policy_info
title: Agent policy
description: Read agent-enforced allowed directories and resource limits. Read-only.

name: fs_list
title: List a folder
description: List a directory inside an agent allowlisted root.

name: fs_stat
title: File information
description: Read file or directory metadata.

name: fs_read
title: Read a file
description: Read a file as UTF-8 text or base64 payload.

name: fs_read_lines
title: Read file lines
description: Read a page of UTF-8 lines. offset_lines is zero-based; negative offsets count back from end of file. Maximum 1000 lines and 256 KiB of output.

name: image_inspect
title: Inspect an image
description: Read PNG/JPEG/GIF or extended WebP dimensions and file metadata from headers only. Does not decode pixels or generate a preview. 32 MiB file limit; 256 KiB header scan.

name: docx_inspect
title: Inspect a Word document
description: Inspect DOCX paragraph/table counts without loading external resources or executing macros. Read-only, 16 MiB ZIP and 8 MiB document XML limits.

name: docx_read_paragraphs
title: Read Word paragraphs
description: Read up to 100 DOCX paragraphs as structured, bounded text. Offset is zero-based; content in tables is included.

name: docx_read_table
title: Read a Word table
description: Read up to 50 rows of a DOCX table, max 20 cells per row; table_index and offset_rows are zero-based.

name: pdf_read
title: Read a PDF
description: Read the text layer of up to 20 PDF pages. start_page is 1-based (default 1); a negative value counts from the end (-1 is the last page). page_count defaults to 5. Scanned pages without a text layer return empty text.

name: xlsx_inspect
title: Inspect an Excel workbook
description: List worksheets in an XLSX/XLSM workbook without running macros. Read-only; compressed limit 16 MiB, expanded ZIP limit 64 MiB.

name: xlsx_read_range
title: Read Excel cells
description: Read up to 50 rows by 20 columns from one worksheet, using 1-based coordinates. Does not evaluate formulas or execute macros.

name: xlsx_find
title: Find in an Excel workbook
description: Search cached cell values in XLSX/XLSM, without evaluating formulas. Bounded to 50,000 cells, 30 sheets, and 100 matches.

name: xlsx_write_cells
title: Write Excel cells
description: Write up to 100 string/number/boolean cells to a NEW XLSX output file without overwriting the original. Existing XLSM files cannot be edited. Optional SHA-256 precondition prevents stale writes.

name: fs_write
title: Write a file
description: Write base64-encoded bytes to an allowlisted file. Optional expected_sha256 rejects stale content; with_undo snapshots an existing regular file (max 4 MiB) for guarded restoration.

name: fs_append
title: Append to a file
description: Append base64-encoded bytes to an allowlisted file. Optional expected_sha256 guards stale appends; with_undo atomically appends to an existing regular file (max 4 MiB) and creates a guarded snapshot.

name: fs_mkdir
title: Create a folder
description: Create a directory.

name: fs_delete
title: Delete a file or folder
description: Delete a file or directory. HIGH risk. Optional expected_sha256 deletes a regular file only if its content is unchanged (atomic on Linux/macOS). Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: fs_move
title: Move or rename
description: Move or rename a file/directory inside the agent allowlisted roots. Destination must not already exist.

name: fs_tree
title: Folder tree
description: Recursively list a bounded directory tree without following symlinks.

name: fs_search
title: Search file names
description: Search file and directory names recursively inside an allowlisted root.

name: text_search
title: Search text
description: Search literal text recursively in bounded UTF-8 files inside an allowlisted root.

name: fs_replace
title: Replace text in a file
description: Perform a guarded UTF-8 search/replace edit. By default the search must match exactly once.

name: fs_versions
title: File versions
description: List at most eight persistent undo snapshots for an allowlisted file.

name: fs_undo
title: Undo a file change
description: Restore a prior fs_replace snapshot only when the current SHA-256 matches. Consumes the snapshot on success.

name: process_exec
title: Run a command
description: Execute a shell command. HIGH risk. Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: process_list
title: List processes
description: List visible processes.

name: process_kill
title: Stop a process
description: Terminate a process. HIGH risk. Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: task_start
title: Start a background task
description: Start a persistent background command task. The task survives AI/gateway disconnects while the agent process remains alive. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: task_status
title: Task status
description: Read status and retained output of a persistent background task.

name: task_cancel
title: Cancel a task
description: Cancel a persistent background task. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: task_list
title: List tasks
description: List retained persistent background tasks so a reconnected AI client can recover task ids.

name: terminal_start
title: Open a terminal
description: Start a persistent PTY session. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: terminal_input
title: Type into a terminal
description: Write at most 256 KiB of decoded bytes to an existing PTY session. HIGH risk: the input runs in the shell, so each exact input needs human approval unless the device is in autonomous mode. Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: terminal_read
title: Read terminal output
description: Read buffered PTY output.

name: terminal_read_page
title: Read terminal history
description: Read non-consuming retained PTY history independently of terminal_read. Positive offset_bytes is an absolute output byte cursor; negative reads from the end. Results report retainedStartBytes and truncatedBeforeOffset when the 1 MiB history cap evicts data.

name: terminal_resize
title: Resize a terminal
description: Resize a PTY session.

name: terminal_stop
title: Close a terminal
description: Stop a PTY session. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: terminal_list
title: List terminals
description: List persistent PTY sessions, process ids and retained output sizes.

name: read_file
title: Read a file
description: Desktop Commander compatible: read a text file. With offset/length, reads a line range (zero-based offset; negative counts from the end). For .pdf files, offset/length are pages (max 20).

name: read_multiple_files
title: Read several files
description: Desktop Commander compatible: read up to ten files.

name: write_file
title: Write a file
description: Desktop Commander compatible: write UTF-8 text. mode 'rewrite' (default) replaces the file, 'append' appends.

name: list_directory
title: List a folder
description: Desktop Commander compatible: list a directory.

name: create_directory
title: Create a folder
description: Desktop Commander compatible: create a directory (with parents).

name: move_file
title: Move or rename
description: Desktop Commander compatible: move or rename a file or directory.

name: get_file_info
title: File information
description: Desktop Commander compatible: file or directory metadata.

name: edit_block
title: Edit part of a file
description: Desktop Commander compatible surgical edit: replace old_string with new_string. Exact match first; if absent, a whitespace-tolerant match is used only when it is unique. expected_replacements (default 1) must equal the number of matches. The write is guarded by the file's SHA-256, so a concurrent change is never overwritten.
